verdict.rationale: Slack ships built-in AI (Slackbot as "personal AI agent", AI-generated huddle notes, channel/thread summaries, daily recaps, and integrated assistants like Claude) directly inside the product, letting users delegate tasks such as meeting prep, report analysis, and note-taking without leaving Slack. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of task delegation quality and outcomes, and detail on the scope/limits of what Slackbot can autonomously execute versus just summarize.
